<function name="GetRunSpeed" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the player's sprint speed.

See also <page>Player:SetRunSpeed</page>, <page>Player:GetWalkSpeed</page> and <page>Player:GetMaxSpeed</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The sprint speed</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints the players run speed in the code.</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):GetRunSpeed() )</code>
	<output>500</output>

</example>
